description: Final generation config of 2026-10-12 (cluster_runs/REPORT_FULLRUN_20261012.md). Horizontal pitch (r1 motion); family quotas with a soft maximum; up to 16 reserve tasks per scene; occlusion_alignment's final frame only needs the occluder identifiable; confirmed annotation errors ignored; FOV off; reproducible work-unit budget of 600 units (about 600 s of single-core time on the fujian login pod), chosen so that the same 1 of the 100 sample scenes hits it as with the old 600 s wall-clock budget.
